question: Does a complete R-557 ten-field source-owner packet, together with the registered full-domain J/D estimates, instantiate every R-565 cut while preserving the exact PAH-001 model and j-before-anchored-n order?
purpose: Make the re-entry condition exact without repeating an owner search or constructing a new comparison map. The R-565 cuts are a coarse admission frontier; this contract tests their coverage by the R-557 field-level packet and preserves the distinction between necessary cuts and sufficient analytic estimates.

fixed_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 and its original finite stationary PH/LK/AP/TR dynamics.
fixed_scope.state: The original labelled Gibbs state and normalization only.
fixed_scope.time: External stochastic Markov time on compact finite intervals [0,T].
fixed_scope.order: j tends to infinity at fixed n first, then anchored n.
fixed_scope.target: The R-512 minimal closed-form semigroup at the declared scope.
fixed_scope.forbidden: No function, rate, state, carrier, regulator, counterterm, direct sum, physical-time interpretation or limit-order change.

packet_fields.meaning: Versioned signer, provenance, SHA-256 and non-post-hoc owner authority.
Root labels, multiplicities, duplicate-transition and invalid-move/root-measure convention.
Finite measurable spaces, target H, domain and measure-compatible U_n or equivalent path map.
Local-cylinder stabilization and norm/inner-product recovery with explicit N(f).
Weak liminf and compatible limsup/recovery for target-form vectors.
Compact-time boundary escape/non-explosion control for the unchanged unbounded generator.
Identification with the R-512 minimal closed form.
Fixed-n j-to-infinity residual estimate for every declared local cylinder pair.
Anchored-n target defect D_n tending to zero on the same declared domain.
Primary, independent, hostile and Lean manifests for the model-specific packet.

admission_predicates.complete_packet: All ten R-557 fields are source-authorized, hash-pinned and jointly compatible with unchanged PAH-001.
admission_predicates.refinement: complete_packet implies minimal_cut_set; minimal_cut_set alone is not sufficient because it does not encode authority, field provenance or verification.
admission_predicates.analytic_consequence: complete_packet AND full-domain J-zero AND anchored D-zero AND nonnegative J+D error bound implies the registered nested ordered-error conclusion.

formal_consequence.error_budget: For every declared local f,g and T, 0<=err(n,j;f,g,T)<=J(n,j;f,g,T)+D(n;f,g,T).
formal_consequence.fixed_n: For each n and epsilon>0, J(n,j)<epsilon/2 eventually as j increases.
formal_consequence.anchored_n: For each epsilon>0, D(n)<epsilon/2 eventually as n increases.
formal_consequence.conclusion: For every epsilon>0 there is N such that each n>=N has a J(n) with err(n,j)<epsilon for all j>=J(n), uniformly on [0,T].

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only a concrete source-authorized packet satisfying all ten fields and all analytic estimates may advance PAH-OMC-020.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: The crosswalk is auxiliary when the packet is absent; the minimal cuts remain missing and the actual route stays HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Reserved for an exact unchanged-source contradiction in the crosswalk or formal consequence, not for packet absence.

next_single_question: Can a versioned source-authorized packet fill all ten R-557 fields and supply the model-specific J/D estimates without changing PAH-001 or its j-before-anchored-n order?
non_claims: The coarse R-565 cut-set alone is not treated as a source packet or an analytic convergence proof.
No common Hilbert space, U_n, path law, generator, compensator, carrier, rate, state, regulator or limit is constructed.
No infinite-volume, continuum or physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion is made.
External Markov time remains stochastic bookkeeping and is not quantum, proper or Lorentzian time.
